validation.reason: validate-spec accepted the workflow and plan-spec rendered the evaluate stage with the pinned module and configured S3 input/output paths. This does not establish runtime readiness.

task_fidelity.reason: Commands invoke the pinned official evaluator for prescribed cases; all 1000 report commands were accepted by upstream argparse. No policy score or training result is established.

output_storage.reason: Selected-project storage and exact private-prefix write/read probes passed for development. Operators must still replace the template bucket and verify their own output prefix.

worker_input.reason: Task-scoped approval was recorded and exact official asset archives and the radio checkpoint were staged privately. The template still requires operator-prepared mounted assets and policy configuration; real rollout validation remains pending.

credentials.reason: Selected-project storage and provider authentication passed, and the exact pinned upstream asset and model payloads were accessed. Credentials and licensed payloads remain private.

source_image.reason: The template runtime image is an operator placeholder. Private development uses a digest-pinned public bootstrap image with a separately prepared official Isaac Sim 5.1 runtime; simulator and policy compatibility remain unverified.

target_runtime.reason: The official radio policy loaded its verified checkpoint and passed HTTP readiness on RTX PRO 6000. The first simulator startup failed on a compute-only target without graphics mounts; its evidence was retained. A replacement rendering target passed stability, CUDA, GLX/EGL loading, and NVIDIA Vulkan enumeration on both GPU nodes. Official rollouts remain unverified.
